name: geovanny
description: Sistema de gestión comercial multimoneda — compras, inventario, ventas, cartera y tasas

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n base,codigo,api,web -c gray,gray,blue,magenta "npm:dev:db" "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
